heading_en: Required Capital Ratio of the Underlying Assets under the Internal Ratings-Based Approach (K_{IRB})
summary_ja: IRBプールに係るK_{IRB}の算出方法(所要自己資本の額の合計額を裏付資産のエクスポージャー総額で除した値)と、証券化目的導管体、ヘッジ取引、購入債権、混合プールの場合の取扱いを定める。
summary_en: Defines K_{IRB} as total required capital of the underlying assets divided by their total exposure amount, with rules for securitization special purpose entities, hedging derivatives, credit risk mitigation, purchased receivables and mixed pools.
paragraphs: Where the securitization exposure is a securitization exposure relating to an IRB pool, the required capital ratio of the underlying assets under the internal ratings-based approach (K_{IRB}) in the preceding two Articles shall be the value, expressed as a decimal, obtained by dividing the total of the required capital amounts calculated under the internal ratings-based approach for the exposures of the underlying assets (including exposures relating to off-balance-sheet asset items; the same applies hereinafter in this Article and the next Article) (meaning the amount obtained by adding the expected loss amount and 8% of the amount of credit risk-weighted assets; the same applies in paragraphs (4) and (7)) (hereinafter in this Article and the next Article referred to as the "total required capital amount of the underlying assets") by the total amount of the exposures of those underlying assets.

In calculating K_{IRB} in the preceding paragraph, where a securitization special purpose entity is used in the securitization transaction, all exposures of that securitization special purpose entity shall be treated as underlying assets; provided, however, that this does not apply to exposures that are clearly immaterial.

In calculating the total required capital amount of the underlying assets in paragraph (1), even where the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach that holds the securitization exposure referred to in that paragraph does not directly hold or purchase the underlying assets, it shall be deemed to directly hold or purchase those underlying assets.

In calculating K_{IRB} in paragraph (1), where the underlying assets include a derivative transaction for the purpose of hedging, such as an interest rate swap or currency swap (excluding credit default swaps), the required capital amount relating to the credit risk to the counterparty of such a transaction shall be included in the total required capital amount of the underlying assets, and the amount of the exposure relating to the credit risk to the counterparty of such a transaction shall not be included in the total amount of the exposures of the underlying assets.
In calculating K_{IRB} in paragraph (1), the effect of credit risk mitigation techniques applied to the underlying assets may be taken into account.

In calculating the total required capital amount of the underlying assets and the total amount of the exposures of the underlying assets in paragraph (1), the specific allowance for loan losses on the exposures of the underlying assets and the discount portion (limited to non-refundable ones) of purchased receivables shall not be taken into account.

In calculating the total required capital amount of the underlying assets in paragraph (1), where the underlying assets include purchased receivables, the sum of the required capital amount for the portion equivalent to default risk and the required capital amount for the portion equivalent to dilution risk relating to those purchased receivables shall be the required capital amount relating to those purchased receivables; provided, however, that where the portion equivalent to dilution risk is immaterial, only the required capital amount for the portion equivalent to default risk may be taken as the required capital amount relating to those purchased receivables.

Notwithstanding the preceding paragraphs, where the securitization exposure is a securitization exposure relating to a mixed pool (limited to one for which d in the following formula is 95% or more), K_{IRB} in the preceding two Articles shall be the value obtained by the following formula. Required capital ratio of the underlying assets = d × K_{IRB} + (1 − d) × K_{SA} d, K_{IRB} and K_{SA} are each as follows. d is the proportion that the total amount of the exposures of the portion of the underlying assets of the securitization exposure relating to the mixed pool that satisfies all of the requirements in Article 1, item (lxxiii)(a) and (b) represents of the total amount of the exposures of the underlying assets relating to that mixed pool. K_{IRB} is the K_{IRB} calculated, applying mutatis mutandis the provisions up to the preceding paragraph, for the portion of the underlying assets of the securitization exposure relating to the mixed pool that satisfies all of the requirements in Article 1, item (lxxiii)(a) and (b). K_{SA} is the K_{SA} calculated under the provisions of Article 243 for the portion of the underlying assets of the securitization exposure relating to the mixed pool that fails to satisfy either of the requirements in Article 1, item (lxxiii)(a) and (b).
